mutations.label: the catalogue names a snapshot no read answers for, which is the invented identifier #389 exists to remove
a machine is born with no root volume, so a client cannot find the disk it must not delete
the root volume is cut from no snapshot, so the mapping's provenance names nothing
the root device answers DeleteOnVmDeletion false, where the recorded account answers true on every read of its machine's life
terminating a machine leaves its root volume behind, although the API published DeleteOnVmDeletion true on it
terminating a machine destroys the volume the client linked, although its link published DeleteOnVmDeletion false
a refused batch leaves the root volume of the machine it undid, linked to a machine the client was told it never got
the link filter answers a constant, so a client filtering on DeleteOnVmDeletion selects nothing
a catalogue snapshot can be deleted, stranding every image that names it
a volume cannot be cut from a catalogue snapshot, so the snapshot a client can read is one it cannot use
createImage stores an Iops it cannot honour, which makes the ReadImages decline fiction for one of the two kinds of object it answers
a machine from an image that names no snapshot borrows the catalogue's, which is a relation that resolves and is false
a machine from an image with no mapping gets a zero-sized disk, so a client sizing a root device reads nothing
an unknown image resolves to no catalogue entry, so #392's machine gets a disk with no provenance instead of the default image's
